<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<TravelMessage VersionID="3.1">
    <Control Language="NL" Test="nee">
        <SenderSessionID>{{SenderSessionID}}</SenderSessionID>
        <ReceiverSessionID />
        <Date>{{ControlDate}}</Date>
        <Time>{{ControlTime}}</Time>
        <MessageSequence>1</MessageSequence>
        <SenderID>{{SenderID}}</SenderID>
        <ReceiverID>TUI</ReceiverID>
        <RequestID>AddProAvailabilityTransportRequest</RequestID>
        <ResponseID>AddProAvailabilityTransportResponse</ResponseID>
    </Control>
    <TRequest>
        <SellRequest>
            <PackageDetails>
                <PackageID>{{PackageDetailsPackageID}}</PackageID>
                <NumberOfAdults>{{NumberOfAdults}}</NumberOfAdults>
                <NumberOfChildren>{{NumberOfChildren}}</NumberOfChildren>
                <NumberOfBabies>{{NumberOfBabies}}</NumberOfBabies>
                <DepartureDate>{{DepartureDate}}</DepartureDate>
                <DeparturePoint>{{TransportTransportToDeparturePointPointID}}</DeparturePoint>
                <BoardType>{{AccommodationUnitBoardBoardType[0]}}</BoardType>
                <Duration DurationType="nachten">{{Duration}}</Duration>
                <PackageType>PAKK</PackageType>
            </PackageDetails>
            <Transport>
                <TransportTo>
                    <TransportID>{{TransportTransportToTransportID}}</TransportID>
                    <TransportType>{{TransportTransportToTransportType}}</TransportType>
                    <Carrier>
                        <CarrierID>{{TransportTransportToCarrierCarrierID}}</CarrierID>
                        <Description>TuiFlyNe</Description>
                        <FlightNumber>{{TransportTransportToCarrierFlightNumber}}</FlightNumber>
                        <Stopovers NumberOfStops="0">
                        </Stopovers>
                    </Carrier>
                    <Departure>
                        <Point PointType="IATAcode">
                            <PointID>{{TransportTransportToDeparturePointPointID}}</PointID>
                        </Point>
                        <Date>{{TransportTransportToDepartureDate}}</Date>
                    </Departure>
                    <Arrival>
                        <Point PointType="IATAcode">
                            <PointID>{{TransportTransportToArrivalPointPointID}}</PointID>
                        </Point>
                        <Date>{{TransportTransportToArrivalDate}}</Date>
                    </Arrival>
                    <Class>
                        <ClassID>{{TransportTransportToClassClassID}}</ClassID>
                        <Seats>{{Seats}}</Seats>
                    </Class>
                </TransportTo>
                <TransportFrom>
                    <TransportID>{{TransportTransportFromTransportID}}</TransportID>
                    <TransportType>{{TransportTransportFromTransportType}}</TransportType>
                    <Carrier>
                        <CarrierID>{{TransportTransportFromCarrierCarrierID}}</CarrierID>
                        <Description>TuiFlyNe</Description>
                        <FlightNumber>{{TransportTransportFromCarrierFlightNumber}}</FlightNumber>
                        <Stopovers NumberOfStops="0"></Stopovers>
                    </Carrier>
                    <Departure>
                        <Point PointType="IATAcode">
                            <PointID>{{TransportTransportFromDeparturePointPointID}}</PointID>
                        </Point>
                        <Date>{{TransportTransportFromDepartureDate}}</Date>
                    </Departure>
                    <Arrival>
                        <Point PointType="IATAcode">
                            <PointID>{{TransportTransportFromArrivalPointPointID}}</PointID>
                        </Point>
                        <Date>{{TransportTransportFromArrivalDate}}</Date>
                    </Arrival>
                    <Class>
                        <ClassID>{{TransportTransportFromClassClassID}}</ClassID>
                        <Seats>{{Seats}}</Seats>
                    </Class>
                </TransportFrom>
            </Transport>
            <Responsibilities>
                <SalesResponsibility>Agent</SalesResponsibility>
            </Responsibilities>
        </SellRequest>
    </TRequest>
</TravelMessage>

    <Control Language="NL">

                <DepartureDate>{{DepartureDate}}</DepartureDate>

            </PackageDetails>
            <PaxDetails>
                <PaxID>{{Person1PaxID}}</PaxID>

            </PaxDetails>
            <PaxDetails>
                <PaxID>{{Person2PaxID}}</PaxID>
                <DateOfBirth>{{Person2DateOfBirth}}</DateOfBirth>
            </PaxDetails>
            <Transport>
                <TransportTo>
                    <TransportID>{{TransportTransportToTransportID}}</TransportID>
                    <TransportType>{{TransportTransportToTransportType}}</TransportType>
                    <Carrier>
                        <CarrierID>{{TransportTransportToCarrierCarrierID}}</CarrierID>
                        <Description>TuiFlyNe</Description>
                        <FlightNumber>{{TransportTransportToCarrierFlightNumber}}</FlightNumber>
                        <Stopovers NumberOfStops="0"></Stopovers>

                    <Departure>
                        <Point PointType="IATAcode">
                            <PointID>{{TransportTransportToDeparturePointPointID}}</PointID>

                        <Date>{{TransportTransportToDepartureDate}}</Date>

                    <Arrival>
                        <Point PointType="IATAcode">

                    </Arrival>
                    <Class>
                        <ClassID>{{TransportTransportToClassClassID}}</ClassID>

                        <PaxID>{{Person1PaxID}}</PaxID>
                        <PaxID>{{Person2PaxID}}</PaxID>
                    </Class>
                </TransportTo>
                <TransportFrom>
                    <TransportID>{{TransportTransportFromTransportID}}</TransportID>
                    <TransportType>{{TransportTransportFromTransportType}}</TransportType>
                    <Carrier>
                        <CarrierID>{{TransportTransportFromCarrierCarrierID}}</CarrierID>
                        <Description>TuiFlyNe</Description>
                        <FlightNumber>{{TransportTransportFromCarrierFlightNumber}}</FlightNumber>
                        <Stopovers NumberOfStops="0"></Stopovers>
                    </Carrier>
                    <Departure>
                        <Point PointType="IATAcode">
                            <PointID>{{TransportTransportFromDeparturePointPointID}}</PointID>
                        </Point>
                        <Date>{{TransportTransportFromDepartureDate}}</Date>
                    </Departure>
                    <Arrival>
                        <Point PointType="IATAcode">

                    <Extras>
                        <ExtraID>{{APTransportToExtraLuggageID[1]}}</ExtraID>

                        <From>

                        <ExtrasPax>

                            <PaxID>{{Person2PaxID}}</PaxID>

                        <RelatedTransport>

                    <UnitID>{{AccommodationUnitUnitID[0]}}</UnitID>
                    <UnitType>{{AccommodationUnitUnitType[0]}}</UnitType>
                    <Board>
                        <BoardType>{{AccommodationUnitBoardBoardType[0]}}</BoardType>

                    <RoomAssignment>

                        <PaxID>{{Person2PaxID}}</PaxID>
                    </RoomAssignment>
                </Unit>
            </Accommodation>
        </ReceiptRequest>
    </TRequest>
</TravelMessage>
